text:
Jordan: Hill sprints after work today — 6:00pm meet at the loading dock? Quick 3x400m uphill (hard) vs easy dog-park 5k loop at 6:15 (chill). Vote with emoji: :fire: for hill sprints, :paw_prints: for dog loop. Map: https://maps.app.link/example
Priya: Hmm I actually have a bouldering slot at 6:30 at Midtown. Would swap to climb if others want — @Maya you coming? :rock_on:
Lina: Are hill sprints newbie friendly? Never done them. :sweat_smile:
Ethan: Dog loop for me — pace easy (~7:30/mile). Can bring water for dogs. :dog:
Maya: I can bring a crash pad and chalk if we go bouldering. If hill sprints, I’ll join too but low-key. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Cool — looks split. If no boulder majority by 5:30 we go hill sprints. Otherwise we do gym.
Priya: Midtown gym, 6:30 — route setting day so should be fun. Shoes and chalk. Anyone borrowing pads?
Ethan: Might swing by gym after my dog loop. If someone can save a pad for me that’d be rad.
Lina: Ok I’ll try hill sprints then — meet at loading dock? Any warm-up tips?
Maya: Warm-up: 10min easy jog + dynamic legs, then 2 build-ups, then 4x30s hard with walk back. Don’t max on first rep. I’ll demo at the top.
Jordan: Perfect — plan: meet 6:00 loading dock for warm-up, decide there. Btw dog route has a weird muddy patch by the north gate today.
StepsBot: Weekly step leaderboard updated: Jordan +1,242, Priya +812, Lina +593 — keep it up! :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya: @Lina if you want I can show a couple easy holds before you try the hill sprints — hand/foot placement stuff helps.
Lina: Thanks! Appreciate the help. See folks at 6. :smile:
Maya: I’ll bring a spare shirt and a small first-aid kit just in case.
Ethan: See you — bringing extra water. :sweat_drops:
